Disconnecting an integration deletes or invalidates the corresponding access data on the VEINMusic side; if necessary, access can also be revoked in the external service itself.
Для входа сайт использует защищённую Htt: For sign-in, the site uses a secure HttpOnly cookie with a session token. A session lasts about 30 days, and temporary authorization cookies of external services live considerably shorter. Another HttpOnly cookie with a random device identifier (up to two years) makes it possible to recognize a sign-in from a new device and warn you about it. To protect against password guessing, spam and excessive numbers of requests, the server may also temporarily process the IP address and attempt counters (no longer than one day), and an administrator may temporarily restrict access from an address an attack is coming from. If the “I’m not a robot” check is enabled, at sign-up and after failed sign-in attempts it is loaded from the servers of its provider (Yandex SmartCaptcha or Cloudflare Turnstile), which receives your IP address and browser information. Metadata of API keys and connected devices, the browser’s push subscription, webhook URLs and information about their use may also be stored separately.
VEINMusic содержит социальные функции, п: VEINMusic has social features, so some data may be public within the service: your username, filled-in profile fields, comments, likes, following and related interface elements.
